Stock market news | Adani Enterprises and Adani Power Plan Public Bond Sale

Adani Enterprises and Adani Power are planning public bond offerings to raise at least ₹2,000 crore, which equals 220 million dollars. Both companies are currently working with local bond arrangers for the upcoming public bond sale.
